_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 65 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 157,575 berths as of December 31, 2023'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2023 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, our Global Brands and our Partner Brands have a combined fleet of 65 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 157,575 berths as of December 31, 2023'; 'We compete with a number of cruise lines as well as land-based vacation alternatives for consumers’ leisure time'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'Demand for cruises is affected by international, national, and local economic conditions' (its own FY2023 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.21x; +36% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.29; conservative 2yr +42%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY14-FY23 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +24.0%/yr (Q1 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +24.0%/yr (FY14-FY23 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +33.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY14-FY23 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2024-03-22) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.21x (16.9% downside to Bear $113 / +80.9% upside to Bull $246) | Adj composite 2.97 vs market 1.68: gap +1.29 [UNDERVALUED] | +36% above the EPP floor $100 (10x FY24E $10.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +42.3% total (+21.2%/yr) | At 13.6x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $180 sits at or below the BASE case; Net Yields n/r in Q4 2023, forward net revenue +26.37-26.92% (Q1 2024 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
